scientific_integrity: The minimality bound is a forced negative penultimate coefficient of the inverse pgf below the proposed threshold. Sufficiency follows from a finite hypergeometric polynomial identity and a strictly positive descending recurrence, with normalization at one. Exact rational verification tests 162 parameter-size cases without replacing the general analytic proof.
scientific_limitations: Finite beta-binomial count laws with arbitrary positive real beta shapes and ordinary fixed-probability independent Bernoulli thinning. Neither random-parameter quasi-Pólya thinning nor general mixtures are covered. A hidden older equivalence in count-dilation literature remains a bibliographic risk.
title: Exact ordinary-thinning threshold and punctured parent for every beta-binomial law
